results.description:
Plan, navigate and connect with a network of dealers and riders using the official app from Harley-Davidson®. 

COMMUNITY 
Make new connections, create or join groups, and find events in your local area or at your next destination.  

MEMBERSHIP 
Create a custom profile, track your points, and connect with your local dealership. Earn points with purchases and in-app activities. 

MAPS & RIDE PLANNING 
Plan a custom route by adding waypoints, Harley-Davidson® dealers, gas stations and restaurants along the way. Your custom routes are synced with the routes you create on www.h-d.com/rideplanner.   

RECORDING & SHARING RIDES 
Share your rides with friends. From custom planned routes or favorite local rides to that epic ride you just recorded. 

GPS NAVIGATION 
Stay on course with turn-by-turn GPS navigation. Choose a destination or plan an epic route.   

CHALLENGES 
Participate in riding challenges, climb the leaderboard, and earn achievements including reward points. 

HARLEY-DAVIDSON® DEALERS 
Locate and navigate to any dealership using GPS navigation. Connect with dealers, see their services, hours and upcoming events. 

YOUR HARLEY-DAVIDSON® GARAGE 
Manage your Harley-Davidson Motorcycles and ensure they are maintained and recall free. On select vehicles with Bluetooth connectivity you can display your routes on your bike’s infotainment system.

The app provides a portal for users to:

• Schedule Appointments
• View Special Offers
• Start a Chat for any questions they have
• View Services in their Maintenance Plan (where applicable)
• Utilize the Digital Glovebox
• And update contact information when needed.

It's your one-stop shop for all your automotive needs.

results.description:
Shop auto parts, car parts, motorcycle parts, batteries, brake pads, brake rotors, wipers, and more, all in one place.
With the AutoZone app, it’s easier than ever to shop online and take care of your vehicle, whether you drive a car, truck, SUV, or motorcycle.

Order the right parts and accessories with just a few taps. From brake rotors and wipers to motorcycle batteries and more, get what you need fast with same-day store pickup or convenient ship-to-home delivery.

Track your AutoZone Rewards balance and access your local store information right from the home screen.
With AutoZone on your phone, you're that much closer to getting back on the road—with the auto parts you need, when you need them.

BUY ONLINE, PICK UP IN STORE OR SHIP TO YOUR HOME
Easily get car parts, brake pads, and other essential items the same day with store pickup, or have them shipped directly to your house.

SAME DAY DELIVERY
Delivery in 3hrs or less on orders placed by 6PM. Get it fast! Available in select markets.

STORE LOCATOR
With over 6,000 stores across the U.S., the Store Locator helps you find the most convenient location—no matter where you are. Set your store to check pricing and availability on thousands of auto parts, including wipers, batteries, and more.

VIN DECODER
Use the VIN scanner to add your vehicle automatically and find the right car parts faster.

LICENSE PLATE LOOKUP
Find your vehicle by entering your license plate number to retrieve your VIN and quickly identify compatible auto parts.

BARCODE SCANNER
Shopping in-store? Use the barcode scanner to check pricing and specs for any part—including brake pads, batteries, or motorcycle parts.

MANAGE YOUR VEHICLES
Keep track of all your vehicles in one place. Track every job with Service History, explore DIY suggestions with Repair Help, and view full vehicle specs.
Perfect for managing maintenance across cars, trucks, or motorcycles.

REWARDS
Track your AutoZone Rewards balance directly from the home screen. Not a member? Sign up today and start earning money toward your next auto parts purchase.

Bikeminder has maintenance routines for Yamaha, Honda, BMW, KTM, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Harley Davidson and Ducati motorcycles. If your bike isn't listed you can create (and share) your own routine or request one via the support link.

Bikeminder helps you stay on top of your bike’s maintenance with fully customisable maintenance routines. reminders, and a pdf export facility so you can share your service history when you need it.

* Support for multiple vehicles
* iCloud backup as standard
* Download or create a maintenance schedule tailored to your motorcycle
* Get automatic reminders for upcoming tasks
* Track oil changes, safety inspections, insurance documents and more
* Log maintenance activity with notes and photos
* Export your records as a professional PDF

Bikeminder is not affiliated with or endorsed by any motorcycle manufacturer.

results.description:
Contains the description of Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) to help riders/professionals of Harley Davidson motorcycles to identify issues. This app brings an extensive list of codes and their descriptions, separated in 5 categories:

- ABS
- Sensors and Motors
- Battery, Ignition, Lighting, Accessories
- CAN Bus
- Radio Diagnostic

It also has a list of abbreviations used in DTC descriptions.

Please note that this app only shows the description of DTCs. It does not contain detailed information on what to do with these trouble codes.

Braap helps you keep your dirt bike in top shape by tracking maintenance tasks. Simply keep track of your bike's hours, and Braap will display which tasks need to be performed.

When you complete a task it is added to your Bike Log, where you can see your bike's complete maintenance history.

Tasks that you perform before each ride are displayed in a checklist, so you can be sure your machine is ready to go.

All tasks are fully editable, and you can even add your own custom tasks to be tracked!

Braap helps you keep your bike running at it's peak!

results.releaseNotes:
► HIGHLIGHTS
‣ Apple Watch ride tracking is here. Start a ride right from your wrist, leave the phone in your pack, and the ride lands on the right machine when you're back in range. Your hours and miles fill in on their own, and the ride counts toward your Activity rings.
‣ Build a schedule from your own service manual. Hand LookOver the factory manual that came with your machine, the whole PDF, and it finds the interval charts and builds your maintenance schedule for you. A few screenshots of the chart work too.

► IMPROVEMENTS
An empty garage now walks you straight to a real maintenance schedule instead of a blank form. Trial info reads the way it should: no card on file, nothing to cancel. The status note on your Machines list waits for you now instead of taking over the screen. Dozens of refinements.

► BUG FIXES
Ride distance no longer counts the drift of a parked machine, so mileage reminders fire when they should. Metric stays metric. Service costs typed with a comma decimal save correctly. Fixed a schedule editor that overwrote your interval number when you changed its type.
results.description:
You know that feeling. Loading up for the weekend, machines geared up, crew ready, and that question nagging at the back of your head: "Did I forget something?"

LookOver ends the guesswork.

► ONE APP. EVERY MACHINE. ALWAYS READY.
A powersports maintenance tracker for dirt bikes, ATVs, UTVs, snowmobiles, motorcycles, and personal watercraft. Track hours, miles, services, fuel, registrations, and recalls across your whole garage, right down to the truck and trailer. Works offline.

► NEW: START A RIDE FROM YOUR WRIST
Leave the phone in your pack. Pick a machine on your Apple Watch, hit start, and ride. Your hours and miles land on the right machine when you're back in range, and it counts toward your Activity rings.

► TWO WAYS TO A REAL MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE
Hand LookOver the service manual that came with your machine. The whole PDF, or a few screenshots of the interval chart. It finds the intervals and builds your schedule. No manual handy? Tell us what you ride and how you ride it, and LookOver builds one calibrated to real OEM service charts. Either way, one tap to apply.

► REMINDERS YOU CAN TRUST
Whether your dirt bike tracks hours, your UTV tracks miles, or your sled sits all summer, LookOver handles intervals the way OEMs specify service. Date reminders warn you 7 days and 1 day ahead.

► GUIDANCE ON EVERY REMINDER
Tap a maintenance reminder for a plain-English rundown of the job, the tools and parts you'll need, how-to videos, and shops near you. Dialed in to your machine.

► YOUR GARAGE ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put a machine on your home screen with its hours and miles. Start a ride, log a service, or set a reminder in one tap.

► RECALL ALERTS FOR EVERY MACHINE
LookOver checks every machine against U.S. safety recall databases and notifies you on a match. Free for everyone.

► THE HISTORY TRAVELS WITH THE MACHINE
Selling your dirt bike? Hand the buyer a QR code. Every oil change, top end, and part you logged goes into their LookOver. Free for everyone.

► BUILT FOR RIDERS EVERYWHERE
LookOver runs in 16 languages, and the smart features write in yours too. Your schedule, Garage Note, and Auto Add entries come back in your language. Pick your currency.

► FREE VERSION
‣ Track one machine with full service logging
‣ Home screen widget: start a ride or log a service in one tap
‣ Safety recall alerts with push notifications
‣ Registration, permit, and inspection tracking, no expired paperwork
‣ Garage Note: a friendly heads-up on what needs attention

‣ Reminders by hours, miles, date, or race count, with compound intervals like "50 hours OR 6 months"
‣ Attach up to 3 files per service
‣ PDF service history for resale
‣ Works offline, syncs when connected

► PRO UNLOCKS
‣ Track your whole garage, unlimited machines
‣ Apple Watch ride tracking, no phone required
‣ Build a schedule from your own factory service manual
‣ A maintenance schedule personalized to how you ride
‣ Service Guidance on every reminder: tools, parts, videos, shops
‣ Auto Add: speak or type what you did, LookOver logs it
‣ GPS ride tracking, satellite maps, GPX import
‣ Templates for boats, cars, trucks, RVs, and equipment
‣ Cost tracking and fuel economy per machine, in your currency
‣ Attach up to 20 files per service
‣ Try Pro free for 14 days, no credit card

► WHAT RIDERS SAY
"I race motocross and ATV motocross with 7 bikes year-round. I can be mid-season and know my practice machine needs an oil change while my race machine needs a top end."
Kody C., Washington

"I tried several apps, and LookOver just flowed better overall."

results.description:
Power Vision 4 from Dynojet Research Inc. combined with your iPhone puts you in control of your bike’s engine. Gain access to hundreds of different tunes for various aftermarket components and easily flash any of them to you bike’s ECU.  Unbelievably quick and easy to use; make more power and torque with the push of a button. Advanced users can edit hundreds of individual engine parameters to build a tune that’s dialed in for their unique setup using Dynojet’s integrated cloud tune delivery system.
With the PV4 App and our pocket-sized PV4 device you can:
•	Flash tunes to your ECU – no setup required, just create an account, select your tune, flash, and ride the ultimate ride.
•	Access to vast database of pre-loaded tunes for different configurations – no custom tuning required.
•	Easily download and manage pre-loaded and custom tunes.
•	Record real-time engine data and review in WinPEP 8 Data Center.
•	Read, review, clear, and share diagnostic trouble codes (DTC’s) with built-in descriptions.
•	Flash an unlimited number of bikes with one device.*  
•	Use licenses from your Power Vision Classic with your Power Vision 4.
•	Return to stock at any time – your original, factory tune is safely backed up on the cloud and on your phone.
•	Optimized for remote-tuning.  – Easily ride, record, and share data logs with your tuner for trouble-free custom tuning without a dynamometer.
•	Keep your ECU – The Power Vision 4 reprograms your bike without having to remove or mail-in the ECU. Just plug into the diagnostic connector and flash, it’s really that easy.
•	Autotune - Choose from three different Autotune modes to dial your HD motorcycle in the way that fits you best.
•	Dynamometer Compatible - Plug your PV4 directly into your Dynojet Dynamometer to view channels, flash, read diagnostic information, read RPM via OBD, and load control without an inductive pickup. 
•	Flashes on HD motorcycles as fast as 12.75 seconds (select models)
•	Active Tests help diagnose problems on your HD - cycle the fuel pump, indicators, water pump, and many other components when troubleshooting engine or electrical issues.
•	Diagnostic Routines allow you to bleed the ABS system at home


World class, US-based customer service from our team of motorcycle enthusiasts is also available to suggest the best tune, review data recordings, or assist in troubleshooting.  Your ultimate ride awaits with Power Vision 4 – download the app and see how easy tuning can be! 
 
* First bike license included with purchase of Power Vision 4 device. Requires purchase of license for each additional bike



DISCLAIMER: Not legal for sale or use in California

The Screamin' Eagle Street Tuner App is for use exclusively with the Screamin’ Eagle® Pro Street Tuner Bluetooth communication module that is sold as an accessory for select Harley-Davidson® models. 

The Screamin’ Eagle® Street Tuner App is designed to simplify management of engine operating parameters as performance modifications are made. Once the Tuner hardware module is installed, this app allows you to upload the latest Engine Control Module (ECM) calibrations to match your bike’s state-of-tune or perform a Smart Tune session to tailor the base calibration to your custom ride.

• Download Screamin’ Eagle® calibrations from a vast calibration library
• Perform a Smart Tune session* to tailor the calibration
• Store run-time data
• View performance gauges and vehicle data
• View and clear diagnostics functions

*Smart Tune not available in all markets.
